home.tagline: Book your procurement slot, track your queue, and get paid - without standing in line.
home.feature.bookSlot.title: Book a slot
home.feature.bookSlot.body: Choose your nearest procurement centre and a convenient date and time - no more guessing when to show up.
home.feature.queue.title: Track your queue
home.feature.queue.body: See your token number and how many farmers are ahead of you, in real time.
home.feature.payment.title: Procurement & payment status
home.feature.payment.body: Check how much was procured and when your payment was made, from your phone.
home.feature.report.title: Report an issue
home.feature.report.body: Had a problem at a centre? Let us know and track how it's resolved.
home.feature.centres.title: Find a centre near you
home.feature.centres.body: Browse every procurement centre's timings, crops and current status.
